title: Wso2am: Use of Externally-Controlled Input to Select Classes or Code ('Unsafe Reflection') vulnerability in Apache…
description: A high-severity vulnerability (CVE-2026-70410) affects the wso2am package due to unsafe reflection in Apache Calcite Avatica. This flaw allows the use of externally-controlled input to select classes or code, potentially leading to full compromise of confidentiality, integrity, and availability. Versions prior to 4.7.0-r5 are affected. A patch is available in version 4.7.0-r5.
